node.title: Re^7: Unclear about 'our'
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Perl OO, at its simplest, actually doesn't involve that much boilerplate so that IMHO it's worth it to learn that - see my example below as well as [doc://perlootut] and [doc://perlmod] (Update: and [doc://perlobj]). But when I do use a module, I typically go for [mod://Moo].

package Foo; use warnings; use strict; sub new { my ($class, $bar) = @_; my $self = { bar => $bar }; return bless $self, $class; } sub foo { my $self = shift; print "Bar=", $self->{bar}, "\n"; } 1;
